dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Uhh, I'm actually pretty busy here!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: ...Still, I suppose a quick chat won't hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Let's do it — I know lots of great topics!

choices.text: Do you chat with other people a lot?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Well... the old drunkards try to chat with me all the time.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I never answer them, but that's still not enough to shut them up!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I always make a point of making them the most disgusting cocktail I can come up with.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But they drain every last drop and then ask for another glass! Ugh!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Why do things have to be this way...?

choices.text: What do you like to chat about?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...I like to share my hunting tips with others, but...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: ...The guys at the tavern only wanna talk about the harvest, girls they like, card game strategies... stuff like that.

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I hate it. I make it pretty obvious that I'm not listening, but there's always someone at the bar rattling on to me.
